node_definition.done_when: The currency report at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/s22-coord/review-dies-currency/report.md, item (1), is the brief for the native half only. The operator lane-pause half belongs to plan a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner and is out of scope. A backend whose configuration declares an in-harness launch is dropped from review lane candidates by code, including when it is the owning run's backend or the local backend. When that leaves no lane, the reflex holds the run with the existing no-lane reason rather than creating a pointer. A new tests/test_a_review_never_runs_in_harness.py drives the candidate list with a configuration listing an in-harness backend that review_excluded_backends does not exclude, and asserts it is absent. A second case, with only in-harness backends configured, asserts the run is held with a reason. The named negative control (restore the configuration-only exclusion) reddens both. The gate is the whole tests/ directory with -n 8, at base and at head. Both suite arms are recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any id outside this fence that the change reddens means status blocked, naming each id. Basetemps and scratch trees go under /tmp in a directory named for this run; delete everything created there before status complete, printing what is deleted and listing it in artifacts. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/a-review-never-runs-in-harness.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
